body_markdown:
Join us at the Government Fleet Expo & Conference (GFX) 2026, we would love to meet you; Drop by Beam’s exhibition space #739 and request a custom tour of our EV ARC™ charging system.


Come and discover more about our patented EV ARC™, the only 100% renewable, transportable, off-grid EV charging option on the market. It is a versatile energy infrastructure product with a sleek aesthetic design that fits the size of a standard parking space.


- Rapidly deployed sustainable EV charging
- No electrical work, no construction, no utility bill
- Fits in a standard parking space so EVs can park on the base pad with no loss of precious parking
- Any brand charger pre-mounted at the Beam factory
- Permanent yet movable, the EV ARC™ can be relocated quickly and easily


**Event:** Government Fleet Expo & Conference (GFX) 2026


**Date:** June 9 – 12, 2026


**Location:** Charlotte Convention Center 501 South College St. Charlotte, NC 28202


**Registration is now open[here](https://www.governmentfleetexpo.com/)**


**What Is GFX?**


Government Fleet Expo & Conference (GFX), is the largest annual conference for public fleets in the nation. Built from the ground up by the team behind *Government Fleet* magazine, the most trusted industry resource for news, training and information – GFX is known for its robust conference program, large and immersive exhibition and most of all, serving as a true annual hub for public fleet professionals.


GFX has built a legacy of greatness and connections. Since 2008, our close-knit community has returned each year for our trusted and relied upon public fleet-specific training, networking opportunities with like-minded peers, and access to top products and technology displays.


**Can’t make it to GFX?**


No problem. We’re always available to help you design the perfect solution for your EV charging requirements. Click[here](https://beamforall.com/about/contact-us/) to contact one of our experts.


We look forward to seeing you,


The Beam Team
